name: Lanassa Vasileva
source:
"Knowing that everyone else is probably just as afraid and uncertain as I am, I should make it my job to lead everyone towards a better future!"

Despite the situation, Lanassa makes an effort to remain loving and cheerful, rarely letting the horrors around her get her down too much. Affable and outgoing, she's often the first to praise new ideas when they come up, and is set in the belief that working together is the key to escape.

While she can be rather maternal at times, caring for her fellow participants and taking on a stern, scolding tone when settling minor conflicts, her immature qualities balance out that trait. In many ways, she uses her energy and enthusiasm to try and make others more comfortable, attempting to distract from the situation and spread joy instead.

She does what she can to be a source of support for those around her, though in a sense she depends on them just as much, requiring the encouragement of others to succeed.

[From [url=https://crimsonsugarstudio.wixsite.com/crimson-sugar-studio/meet-the-cast]Crimson Sugar Studio website[/url]]
